items.title: 谷歌 SynthID Detector 简化了水印检测流程，并将支持范围扩展至其他 AI 提供商
items.raw_excerpt: 谷歌 DeepMind 宣布，SynthID Detector 现已面向全球发布。该工具旨在帮助识别由 AI 生成的内容，包括使用 SynthID 合作伙伴（如 OpenAI、NVIDIA 和 Kakao）的 AI 工具创建的媒体内容，预计苹果公司也将很快提供支持。

items.title: Subvocal – Talk to your computer without making noise
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, we're Aarush and Arnav from The Subvocal Company (YC F26). We’re building smart glasses that let you talk to your computer without talking out loud. You can mouth words silently and discreetly and the glasses decode them to text at the speed of speech. Here's a video of Dave from YC trying it out: https://youtube.com/shorts/-L1Qb5oINK4 Arnav and I were studying CS at Georgia Tech at the beginning of the year, with no experience in silent speech or sensing. We were both AI-native builders and power users of Wispr Flow. What bugged us was not being able to use these tools in the library (or an office) or in public. At Stanford’s TreeHacks in February, we decided to build the most technically ridiculous thing we could think of. We’d read about AlterEgo, a silent speech system out of MI

items.title: Momentic (YC W24) – Agents that catch bugs by using your app
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, we’re Wei-Wei and Jeff. We’re building Momentic, QA agents that autonomously plan, explore, and bug-bash controls and user flows in your web, iOS, Android, and (soon) desktop apps to catch bugs. Here’s a demo: https://youtu.be/BFsM-Se1Fh8 We’re both software engineers that spent our careers on dev tooling and infra across companies like Robinhood, Retool, WeWork, and Qualtrics. Testing was always a pain in the ass (esp Playwright and Selenium), so we built agents to do it for us. Modern day software has a ton of bugs and the change failure rate is only growing faster as coding agent adoption scales. LLMs are really good at generating code, but reinforce their own assumptions, write a ton of useless tests, and are bad at visual understanding. On DeepSWE v1.1, Sonnet 5.5 hit 66.2% pa

items.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.raw_excerpt: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.
